purpose: Source-evidence annotations for eight duplicated R49 points with different coordinates under one CL2 physical anchor. No new site identities, public pins, timetables or Mass claims.

records.name: Church of the Holy Name, Stepney

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: FSSP identifies Church of the Holy Name at 80 Payneham Road

records.caution: First R49 FSSP pin is ~564 m from OSM church; LMD marker ~56 m. Use independent church geometry as review candidate, not either stored source marker automatically.

records.name: Church of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary and St Charles the Great, Prague-Karlov

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Church itself identifies Ke Karlovu 453/1, Praha 2

records.caution: Approximately 11 m between R49 source pins; municipal position is closest to the first. Exact public pin/entrance remains a separate release decision.

records.name: St Mary's College Chapel, Galway

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Institute identifies St Mary's College Chapel, Galway
OSM maps St Mary's College school campus; NOT a proof of chapel building or doorway

records.caution: Pins differ by ~234 m. The source near the college campus is plausible but the school's mapped centroid is not proof of chapel geometry. Need chapel or entrance-level evidence.

records.name: Chapelle Notre-Dame du Rosaire, Le Laus

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Official chapel name and 388 Grande Rue, Notre-Dame du Laus

records.caution: Identical latitude 44.521546 and longitude values 6.1537492 versus 6.153749, a difference ~0.02 m. Treat as source-coordinate rounding, not distinct spatial sites. Retain both frozen sources.

records.name: St Francis Xavier Cathedral Crypt, Geraldton

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Diocese confirms cathedral at 56 Cathedral Avenue; crypt position inside building not separately certified

records.caution: OSM church location is ~4 m from LMD and ~295 m from AO-WORLD source. This is a cathedral-building candidate, NOT an independent crypt chapel/entrance survey.

records.name: Mary Immaculate Church, Annerley

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Brisbane Oratory identifies Mary Immaculate at 616 Ipswich Road
Brisbane City Council independently identifies church at same address

records.caution: Independent historic church mapping is ~11 m from LMD and ~68 m from AO-WORLD. The school and church share a parish complex; never substitute a school coordinate for church point.

records.name: Maternal Heart of Mary Church, Lewisham

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: FSSP parish confirms Charles O'Neill Way; presbytery at separate 44 West Street must never be used as church position

records.caution: OSM church is ~9 m from LMD but ~491 m from AO-WORLD source. Church vs presbytery/other site must remain distinct.

records.name: St Joseph's Church, Rochester

owner_or_government_evidence.supports: Secondary source identifies church on Fraser Street and Campaspe Street corner; not coordinate-grade or owner verification

records.caution: About 40 m between two unassessed source markers. Require independently mapped church footprint or official entrance/address confirmation before selecting a candidate.
